coursera.detail: detail.nCoursePairs = distinct course pairs pooled; detail.coursePairs = top-5 behind the edge direction; fromItem/toItem = catalog items the courses belong to

description: Merged, tiered prerequisite edges: authored (skills.json.prereqs, drive paths) annotated with per-source learner-sequence evidence, plus mined-only candidates (display and evidence only unless a human promoted them). Generated by pipeline/merge_edges.py; never hand-edited.

stackoverflow.cohortRule: For pair (A,B) count only users whose first-ever question is >= 12 months after both technologies existed (birth = first appearance of any of the skill's tags on the site); same-day ties dropped; users with 2-40 mapped skills only
stackoverflow.note: tags behind each skill and the cohort rule apply to every stackoverflow block below (kept here once); detail.sample names the data the numbers came from

samples.sede-current: Stack Exchange Data Explorer, current data: users with >= 1 LLM-era question among posts with Id >= 73000000, OwnerUserId % 1 = 0 (100 % of users), full history per user; pairs with an LLM-era endpoint only
